$comment: Per-game identity, read by CMake, Gradle and the publish pipeline. On a game branch set title/slug/description here. Leave bundleId out unless you need a specific one — the pipeline derives <bundle_id_prefix>.<slug>, which keeps games from overwriting each other on a device. startScene (default Main.scn) and windowSize [w, h] (default 1280x800) tell the app shell what to open.
title: WordFall
description: Catch the falling letters and spell words against the clock.
